title: feat(history): enhance plugin-history with undo grouping, canUndo/canRedo, and comprehensive tests

commits.message:
feat(history): enhance plugin-history with undo grouping, canUndo/canRedo, and comprehensive tests

- Add canUndo() and canRedo() to EditorAPI (core types + implementation)
- Enhance createHistoryPlugin() with config support (minDepth, newGroupDelay)
- Add groupChange() utility for batching multiple edits as a single undo step
- Add isHistoryEnabled() utility for detecting plugin presence
- Install historyStateField for state-field-level undo/redo tracking
- Write 17 comprehensive tests covering basic undo/redo, canUndo/canRedo,
  groupChange, isHistoryEnabled, and configuration options
- Add @codemirror/state as direct dependency
